nodes.description: Public string token name, mutable only by the owner through setName.
Public string token symbol 'PWG'.
Public uint256 token decimals value (8).
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; written by transfer, transferFrom, burn and the constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 approval amounts; written by approve and transferFrom.
Public total token supply set once in the constructor to valueFounder.
Circuit-breaker flag toggled by the isOwner-protected stop()/start() functions.
Constant uint256 amount (88888888866666666) minted to the founder address.
Contract owner address, initialised to msg.sender in the constructor and checked by the isOwner modifier.
Constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, mints totalSupply to _addressFounder and emits Transfer.
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to after balance and overflow requires.
Transfers _value from _from to _to using msg.sender allowance.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value, requiring zero for non-zero value changes.
Owner-only circuit breaker that sets stopped = true.
Owner-only circuit breaker that sets stopped = false.
Owner-only function that overwrites the token name state variable.
Burns _value of the caller balance by moving it to the zero address.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, balance key and allowance key throughout the contract.
Unchecked uint256 addition balanceOf[_to] + _value in require statements of transfer and transferFrom (overflow guard that itself can be argued unsafe in 0.4.x).
Unchecked uint256 subtraction balanceOf[address] -= _value in transfer, transferFrom and burn; underflow dependent on prior require guards.
isOwner modifier authorization enforced with assert on the owner state variable; also validAddress/isRunning asserts use msg.sender.
Constructor parameter receiving the founder address that is credited with valueFounder tokens.
Destination address of the transfer call.
Amount of tokens to move in transfer.
Source address whose balance and allowance are debited in transferFrom.
Destination address credited in transferFrom.
Amount of tokens moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.
Address granted an allowance over the caller balance.
Allowance amount assigned to _spender.
New token name assigned by the owner-only setName function.
Amount of tokens burned from the caller balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the constructor.
Constructor parameter _addressFounder is used as the initial token holder in balanceOf.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply = valueFounder.
Constructor credits balanceOf[_addressFounder] with valueFounder.
Constructor reads the constant valueFounder when minting supply.
transfer reads and debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Transfer(msg.sender,...).
Parameter _to is used as the balance key credited in transfer.
Parameter _value is the amount checked and moved in transfer.
transfer mutates the balanceOf mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer evaluates balanceOf[_to] + _value >= balanceOf[_to] as an overflow guard on untrusted amounts.
transfer performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value, an unchecked uint256 subtraction.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender key allowance[_from][msg.sender].
Parameter _from is the address debited and checked for balance and allowance.
Parameter _to is the address credited in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount checked, moved and deducted from allowance.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for _to and _from.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom evaluates balanceOf[_to] + _value >= balanceOf[_to], an unchecked addition guard on untrusted input.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, unchecked subtractions.
approve keys allowance on msg.sender as the token owner.
Parameter _spender is the allowance recipient key in approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written in approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
msg.sender is compared against the owner state variable in the assert of the isOwner modifier.
stop() is gated by the isOwner modifier that asserts owner == msg.sender.
start() is gated by the isOwner modifier that asserts owner == msg.sender.
setName() is gated by the isOwner modifier that asserts owner == msg.sender.
stop() sets the stopped circuit-breaker state variable to true.
start() sets the stopped circuit-breaker state variable to false.
The isRunning modifier makes transfer depend on the stopped flag.
The isRunning modifier makes transferFrom depend on the stopped flag.
The isRunning modifier makes approve depend on the stopped flag.
Parameter _name is assigned to the name state variable.
setName overwrites the token name state variable.
burn reads and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
Parameter _value is the amount burned from the caller balance.
burn decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[0x0].
burn performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value, an unchecked subtraction guarded by a require.
